data_status: 32 records are verified (25 celestial bodies at core level; engines and stages whose core numeric fields were all checked) against retrieved JPL, NASA (NTRS, SLS page, Apollo 11 press kit), ULA and ESA pages. 198 celestial and 44 launch/engine field checks matched; 16 celestial and 13 launch/engine recalled values were wrong or outdated and were replaced by the sourced value. Launch vehicles are verified field by field only (see verified_field_count); everything not checked (e.g. Falcon, Starship, Electron, Ariane, most engines, spacecraft components, instruments, missions) is still unverified, as are two user-supplied tables. Derived values inherit the status of their inputs. Optimization catalog values are estimated/fictional.
